data_truthfulness_warning: All datasets and models generated in this pipeline use synthetic physics simulation. Measured performance metrics reflect simulator behavior and DO NOT represent operational polar field accuracy.

leakage_risks_identified.same_timestep_velocity_predict: Legacy Phase 7 predicted same-step next velocity instead of future multi-horizon displacement windows. Fixed in Phase 11 build_windows.
leakage_risks_identified.sequential_point_leakage: Random train/test splitting of single sequential trajectory points caused temporal leakage. Fixed by implementing track_id group-aware splitting.
leakage_risks_identified.future_forcing_leakage: Ensured input features contain strictly present and past environmental forcing.

findings.fastapi_compatibility: Preserves existing /ml/health and /ml/predict schema and joblib model artifacts while extending support to multi-horizon registry models.
